summary: Security review of sub-muyqje7c-01fe6bf4. Fallback output is fixed (category, urgency) templates with no ticket interpolation; detector and fallback are total and fast on adversarial input within the 8000-char cap; app.js builds the live provider only when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is non-blank, the live path sends only redacted text with the key in x-api-key only; config errors never echo values. npm test 382/382, hygiene test 6/6, pinned check-script hashes match.

criteria.description: Fallback summary/reply never echo ticket text, canaries, URLs or markup (7 adversarial tickets incl. canary tokens, URLs, fake tags, chat tokens, bidi/NUL); fallback total on malformed ticket/detection
Detector and fallback never throw and stay fast on 19 adversarial 16KB inputs and non-string input (worst detector ~90-130ms at 16KB, ~20ms at the 8000-char production cap)

app.js: no/empty/blank key -> fallback mode, fetch never invoked; key set -> live mode, exactly one POST /v1/messages to fake-anthropic, body has no raw card/email/phone, key only in x-api-key header and not in response/meta

Config errors (11 bad envs incl. HOST, PORT, model, base URL with credentials, timeouts, allow-remote) are ConfigError and never echo the value in message or stack; server.js prints only ConfigError message or a sanitised code
Full suite passes on the submitted files
Held-out hygiene test passes (lexical only, per delivery-lead note)
Pinned check-script hashes match plan (dataset-precheck c59b7acd..., readme-check a9a0128f..., scaffold-check e1fde7f9...)

findings.title: LINKISH scheme alternative is quadratic on long dotted/hyphenated runs
findings.detail: detectInjection on 'a.'/'a-' repeated scales O(n^2): 8.5ms@4k, 23ms@8k, 78ms@16k, 278ms@32k chars (ev:ev-muyqml2y-01be22e4). Likely cause: \b[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\/\/ in LINKISH restarts at every word boundary and scans to the end of the sentence. Bounded in production by MAX_TICKET_CHARS=8000 (~20ms worst), so not exploitable as DoS today, but the module's comment claims linear-ish cost and it would degrade if the cap were raised.
findings.recommendation: Bound the scheme run (e.g. [a-z][a-z0-9+.-]{0,31}:\/\/) and add a timing regression test on an 8000-char dotted run.

findings.title: Hygiene test is lexical only; RISK-11 npm-start orphan noted
findings.detail: Acknowledged per delivery-lead notes: heldout-hygiene detects copied phrases/canaries/URLs lexically, not paraphrased leakage; RISK-11 (npm start leaves an orphaned child on signal) is recorded with README mitigation planned in t16. Not re-verified here beyond running the hygiene test (ev:ev-muyqmlep-0138d392).
findings.recommendation: Keep RISK-11 open until the t16 README mitigation lands.
